name: test-driven-development
title: Test-Driven Development
summary: Drive behavior implementation with a failing test first, then minimal passing code and refactoring; use for feature, bugfix, and behavior-change tests.

use_when: Implementing a new feature or behavior change
Fixing a bug; the failing test is the regression check
Refactoring code whose behavior must be preserved
Writing a regression test when implementation changes are not requested
avoid_when: The root cause of a failure is unknown — use debugging first
Designing suite-level test strategy, coverage, or E2E flows — use test-strategy
Documentation-only or configuration-only changes with no runtime behavior
Throwaway prototypes or spikes — state the exception explicitly
